data.heading: Flavours worth slowing down for
data.subheading: Charcoal-kissed kebabs, overnight dal and biryani sealed the old way — served in a candle-lit room in the heart of Lower Parel.

data.heading: Home-style recipes, cooked with fire and patience
data.description:
Saffron Table opened in 2016 in a restored mill building in Lower Parel. Our menu travels across India — from the kebab lanes of Lucknow to the toddy shops of Kerala — and everything is made in-house, from the spice blends to the paneer.

Dal cooks overnight on the embers of our tandoor, breads are baked to order and our biryani is sealed and slow-cooked the old way.

items.question: Is there a dress code?
items.answer: Smart casual. We ask guests not to wear sleeveless vests or shorts for dinner on weekends.

items.question: Do you have vegetarian and vegan options?
items.answer: Yes — more than half the menu is vegetarian, with vegan dishes marked on the menu. Our vegetarian dishes are prepared in a separate section of the kitchen.

items.question: Can I bring a cake?
items.answer: Of course. Tell us when you book and we will keep it chilled and bring it out with candles.

items.question: Is parking available?
items.answer: Complimentary valet parking is available for dinner guests.

data.content:
We use the details you share through this website — your name, phone number, email and booking details — only to manage your reservation or reply to your message. We do not sell or share them with anyone except where needed to fulfil your request.

Write to us to have your details corrected or deleted.

Reservations

Tables are held for 15 minutes after the booking time. Bookings for 8 or more guests may require a deposit, adjusted against the bill.

Prices

Menu prices are in Indian rupees and exclude GST. Service charge is not added to the bill; tips are at your discretion.
